transcript.text:
I couldn't make the poster. Magic Hour refused the job because your account has no credits left. Even the cheapest free-plan image models cost credits, so any model would hit the same block.

Here's what I tried: a portrait (9:16) poster at 640px on qwen-image-2.1, a free-plan model. It had a big "BOOK SWAP" headline, the line "Bring a book, take a book", colorful stacks of books in a flat illustration style, and room at the bottom for event details.

To go ahead:
- Wait for your free credits to refill, or add credits or upgrade your plan in Magic Hour, then tell me to try again.
- If you want, send me the event details now (date, time, place, any rules such as "1 book in = 1 book out"), along with a colour scheme or style you like. I'll put them in the poster when I run it again.
transcript.why: The reply says the poster could not be made because the Magic Hour account has no credits, and even free-plan models cost credits. It states the blocker is the account's plan and credit state, not a choice or approval. It asks for event details, but the main outcome is that the task cannot be done now.

transcript.text: Background colour? Your call on that one only. Keep the exact wording, black lettering and no pictures.

I tried again with your changes, and Magic Hour refused it for the same reason: your account still has no credits left. Nothing was made and nothing was charged.

This is the version I sent, and it's ready to run once you have credits:
- Wording, exactly: "BOOK SWAP" as a big headline, with "Bring a book, take a book" underneath
- All lettering in black, text only, with no pictures, icons or decorations
- Background: I chose a solid warm mustard yellow, which makes black text stand out strongly
- Portrait (9:16), 640px, on the free-plan model qwen-image-2.1

When your credits refill or you add more, say "go" and I'll run it as it is.
transcript.why: The reply says the image run failed because the account has no credits left, so nothing was made. The assistant cannot run the job until credits are added. It asks the user to say "go" later, but the blocking condition is missing credits, not a choice or confirmation the user must give now.
